independent_scout.precision: rounded centre only; exact hit ID and scan epoch still required
independent_scout.origin: Published RFI in paired source/reference scans; proposed network attribution not confirmed

independent_scout.scope: RFICODE probable attribution; not automatically verified source identity

frozen_gate.reference: Only exact audited measured references and provenance; R33B2 rounded figure-guided candidates are not admitted unless independently reviewed and exact join documented.
frozen_gate.partition: Disjoint source families, acquisition dates, original scans, hashes and overlapping spectral windows. BLC1 direct/mirror from one campaign is one grouped exposure; same campaign never used as independent test. Exclude all R29-R33 development targets/dates and all source-derived transformations. External test labels held apart until lock; metadata scout not score selection.
frozen_gate.protected: Independent measured useful source with same native grid or preregistered conservative physical representation validated on independent data. If incompatible only, HOLD. Include blinded weak injections and shared ON/OFF useful-signal stress on real backgrounds separately; report synthetic vs actual.
frozen_gate.primary: Strictly fewer control alerts than Hybrid R28 AND OFF-only at matched sensitivity, zero paired loss of detected weak/localized/protected signals; report all missed baseline signals, ambiguous cases, match coverage and per-family statistics. Raw detections retained. If none qualify, HOLD.
frozen_gate.science: No independent replication claim without external custodian. Public previously studied source labels do not constitute a blind test; freeze exact sources and judge on non-overlapping data; evaluate real origin labels separately from synthetic positives. For independent origin claim use custody split.

source_metadata_preflight.scope: Query official archive metadata only; no spectral power access and no policy selection. Record exact headers if allowed, but no admission from frequency approximation.
